question: Given that $\begin{vmatrix}a&b&c\\p&q&r\\x&y&z\end{vmatrix}=6$, find $\begin{vmatrix}a&b&c\\3p&3q&3r\\x&y&z\end{vmatrix}$ without expansion.
explanation:
Step 1: Observe the change
The second row of the original determinant has been multiplied by $3$, while the other rows remain unchanged.
Step 2: Use the relevant property
If every element of one row of a determinant is multiplied by a number $k$, the value of the determinant is also multiplied by $k$.
Step 3: Apply the property
Thus, $$\begin{vmatrix}a&b&c\\3p&3q&3r\\x&y&z\end{vmatrix}=3\begin{vmatrix}a&b&c\\p&q&r\\x&y&z\end{vmatrix}$$
Step 4: Substitute the value
Therefore, the required determinant is $3(6)=18$. Hence, its value is $18$.
